record.title: Compose sealed capture and SCPI evidence into one bounded offline review
record.intent: Bind each interpretation to exact sealed inputs rather than unrelated individually valid files.
requirements: Add a reusable library with strict versioned TOML role configuration and a required caller-pinned manifest digest; every capture statistics and ordered transcript role must be a distinct member of one exact evidence inventory.

Verify the inventory before and after interpretation; bind consumer hashes and sizes to sealed members and compare selected reconstructed TCP bytes exactly with ordered raw transcript members before SCPI decoding.

Return named stage-specific outcomes with explicit evidence facts; do not promote membership to common physical origin or count agreement to graceful recorder exit delivery or complete traffic acquisition.
Provide bounded file inputs and resource limits; preserve original evidence and perform no physical network process-launch or device operations.
acceptance: Synthetic positive and adversarial consistency controls demonstrate the composed contract.
